name: motif_capture_baseline
description:
Capture a Baseline. Reads the saved .fwdata project to create or reuse a file-backed Baseline. Use it when the latest FieldWorks save should be the point of comparison for later work.
Command: baseline capture. Agent class: Evaluate.
no_background: True captures in the foreground only: no Source index or Parsimony job is queued and no runner is woken, so nothing commits after the command returns.

no_background.description: True captures in the foreground only: no Source index or Parsimony job is queued and no runner is woken, so nothing commits after the command returns.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
